_comment: Backstory row registry. Source of truth for the Lifetimes stratum. Consumed by the classifier prompt, the pairing-line prompt, and the front end. Clocks are computed from start_date at render — never stored.

roots.membership: Who fully belongs, and on what terms?
roots.distribution: How should wealth, risk, and economic power be distributed?
roots.authority: Who may govern, through which institutions, and under what limits?
roots.moral-order: Which moral commitments should public law protect, permit, or enforce?
roots.modernization: How much disruption should the country accept in exchange for adaptation?
roots.security: What does America owe, and risk, beyond its borders?

rows.title: Climate
rows.start_line: since a government scientist told Congress the planet was warming, June 1988
rows.contest: Whether long-term planetary risk warrants remaking how the country makes energy, or whether the remaking costs more than the risk.

rows.title: The Media
rows.start_line: since Washington stopped requiring broadcasters to air both sides, August 1987
rows.contest: Whether a democracy needs common facts from common institutions, or works better when citizens choose their own sources.

rows.title: Immigration
rows.start_line: since the last time Congress passed a big immigration law, November 1986
rows.contest: Whether America renews itself through immigration, or must first settle who belongs and on what terms.

rows.title: Faith
rows.start_line: since a preacher told Christians to organize as a voting bloc, June 1979
rows.contest: Whether public life should stay secular and plural, or reflect a moral inheritance most Americans still hold.

rows.title: Taiwan
rows.start_line: since Washington recognized Beijing and kept arming Taipei, January 1979
rows.contest: Whether deliberate ambiguity is what has kept the peace, or what invites the miscalculation that ends it.

rows.title: Government
rows.start_line: since California voters capped their own property taxes, June 1978
rows.contest: Whether government is the country's common instrument for security and opportunity, or the thing citizens must keep from growing too powerful.

rows.title: Order
rows.start_line: since gun owners took over their own lobby, May 1977
rows.contest: Whether safety comes from stronger enforcement and armed self-reliance, or from limiting coercion and repairing what produces disorder.

rows.title: America Abroad
rows.start_line: since the last helicopter left Saigon, April 1975
rows.contest: Whether American power should actively shape the world, or husband its strength and stay out.

rows.title: Power
rows.start_line: since a president resigned rather than face impeachment, August 1974
rows.contest: Whether institutions should constrain elected power even when that means overruling what voters chose.

rows.title: Work
rows.contest: Whether prosperity comes from freeing capital, or from restoring the bargaining power that once made a job enough.

rows.title: Family
rows.start_line: since a president vetoed universal childcare, December 1971
rows.contest: Whether raising children is a private family responsibility or a shared public one.

rows.title: Equality
rows.start_line: since the Court ruled that separate could not be equal, May 1954
rows.contest: Whether equal citizenship requires the law to act on inherited disadvantage, or requires the law to stop sorting people at all.

rows.title: Korea
rows.start_line: since the shooting stopped without a peace treaty, July 1953
rows.contest: Whether an armistice meant to last months and lasting a lifetime is stability, or just a very long pause.

rows.title: The Bomb
rows.start_line: since the first use of a nuclear weapon in war, August 1945
rows.contest: Whether eighty years without a second use proves deterrence works, or only that we haven't run out of luck.
